item.title: Increase in homelessness in Kerry in 2025 says NOVAS
item.description: There’s been an increase in the number of families and single people in Kerry who’re homeless or at risk of homelessness. That’s according to approved housing body NOVAS which provides accommodation and services in this county. Úna Burns of NOVAS says in October (2025), there were 66 single people who were homeless in Kerry compared to 43 for the same month in 2024. item.title: Sunderland and Leeds draw
item.description: Sunderland have missed the chance to go fifth in the Premier League after being held to a 1-all draw by Leeds. Dominic Calvert-Lewin equalised for the visitors to the Stadium of Light to move them seven points clear of the relegation zone. Crystal Palace could climb into the top six with victory over Tottenham at Selhurst Park this afternoon. item.description: Tralee Chamber Alliance wants to ensure it continues to have a vibrant town centre that drives footfall into the town. item.title: Irish duo set to join coaching set up at Bulls
item.description: Two former Irish internationals are set to join the coaching set up at the Vodacom Bulls in the URC. The club have won just 3 of their 7 league games this season and have requested technical support from the national union. South African media report Jerry Flannery and Felix Jones, will help out in a temporary capacity. Advertisement Both men are assistant coaches with the Springboks and will provide this support alongside their national team duties.
